why: phase-488. Upstream's comes from `std::enable_shared_from_this<LifecycleNode>`, which the extractor does not see as a declared member. Ours returns `LifecycleNode::SharedPtr` (a non-owning handle, like `cpp:Node::shared_from_this`). It was `Node::shared_from_this`, inherited, so the handle named a plain `Node`.
